subject.title: [Bug]: openai-responses sends role="system" instead of role="developer" for reasoning models

question: For custom `openai-responses` providers that reject prompt messages in `input`, should OpenClaw accept a public opt-in instructions-placement compatibility mode, choose a different role/placement policy, or decline core support for that strict-relay class?
rationale: The failure is credible and current main is not fixed, but the safe repair adds provider compatibility configuration and must avoid regressing providers that reject `developer`.

options.title: Sponsor opt-in instructions placement
options.body: Accept the default-preserving compatibility surface, then review and land PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92147 or a rebased replacement with config/docs/tests/live proof.

options.title: Use role-only behavior
options.body: Prefer changing role selection semantics instead, accepting the known risk to OpenAI-compatible providers that reject `developer`.

options.title: Decline core support
options.body: Keep current core behavior and document `openai-completions` or provider-specific workarounds for strict relays that reject prompt messages in Responses `input`.

recommendation.title: Sponsor opt-in instructions placement
recommendation.body: Accept the default-preserving compatibility surface, then review and land PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92147 or a rebased replacement with config/docs/tests/live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider-runtime history and the merged strict Responses payload-shape work make this the best available owner for the config/product contract decision.
